title: Demonstrators clash with police in Bologna over living costs and military spending

tea.why: Protesters are demonstrating against high living costs, rising fuel prices, and increased government military spending.
tea.want: Demonstrators want lower living costs, reduced military expenditure, and a change in economic policies.
tea.changed: Oct 25: Clashes broke out between demonstrators and police in Bologna, leading to six hospitalisations.

summary: Demonstrators clashed with police in Bologna and other Italian cities during protests over rising living costs, fuel prices, and increased military spending. In Bologna, confrontations on Saturday evening led to emergency services receiving numerous calls for assistance, with six individuals taken to hospital. Police deployed tear gas and water cannons in several cities to disperse crowds after demonstrators threw fireworks and bottles. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni condemned the violence, while Interior Minister Matteo Piantedosi ordered the deployment of additional police forces across the country in response to the unrest.
response: According to the sources, police used tear gas and water cannons to disperse crowds. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni condemned the violence, and Interior Minister Matteo Piantedosi ordered the deployment of additional police personnel across major cities.

injuries.text: six people are taken to hospital

updates.text: Clashes occurred between demonstrators and police in Bologna, resulting in six hospitalisations.
